expectation: Membrane stain on endothelial cells, as thin continuous lines and rings lining capillaries and vessels in the lamina propria, submucosa and muscularis. Sparse, 1-5% of cells, with macrophages and platelets less often. Epithelium should be negative.
observed: A: thin yellow lines and loops through the submucosa and lamina propria, with a diffuse haze in the muscularis. B/C: faint haze over epithelium, a few bright vessel-like strands. D: a bright cluster of elongated cells. E1: scattered bright elongated and ring-like cells, some on HLAA+ tissue.
why: Sparse, elongated, vessel-shaped stained structures in the stroma match the endothelial expectation, despite some muscularis haze and weak epithelial background.
